instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make someone else's words safe to quote into what an AI reads, so hidden characters or a fake tag cannot sneak instructions in", and give it text.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:quote-untrusted-words and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give text (another party's words: mail, an imported chat, a web page, a title) and, optionally, max (the most code points the quote may hold, ellipsis included; 8000 when left out).
